## What's the use case

Describe the host-app scenario this would unblock. Concrete > abstract.

## Proposed shape

If you have an API or UX sketch, drop it here. A "this should just work"
issue is fine if the use case is clear.

## Alternatives considered

What works today but is awkward? Why the workaround isn't sufficient?

## Scope check

- [ ] This is in scope of the plugin (passkey / WebAuthn ceremony + UI).
- [ ] Not host-specific business logic that belongs in the consuming app.
- [ ] Not better solved by `web-auth/webauthn-lib` directly.
